questions.question: 1. If the flow time of a sugar solution  (denser than water) is longer than the flow time of water in the viscometer,  what can be inferred about the viscosity of the sugar solution?

answers.a: The sugar solution has a higher viscosity than water
answers.b: The sugar solution has a lower viscosity than water
answers.c: The viscosity of the sugar solution is approximately equal to that of water since sugar solution is denser than water but flows slower than water
answers.d: The viscosity of the sugar solution cannot be compared to that of water since sugar solution is more dense than water

questions.question: 4. Why is it important to measure the density of the sugar solutions accurately in this experiment ?

answers.a: Density is used as an additional way to check the solutions.
answers.b: Density is used in the calculations of the coefficient of viscosity
answers.c: To ensure that the solutions have the correct concentrations
answers.d: Density is used to calculate the volumes of the solutions.
